description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the Amazon HealthLake service, including method signatures for various API operations and associated async variants.

classes.name: HealthLakeClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon HealthLake service, extending the base AWS client, providing methods for HealthLake operations.

methods.name: createFHIRDatastoreAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new FHIR datastore.

methods.name: describeFHIRExportJob
methods.description: Gets details of a FHIR export job.

methods.name: describeFHIRExportJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of a FHIR export job.

methods.name: describeFHIRImportJob
methods.description: Gets details of a FHIR import job.

methods.name: describeFHIRImportJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of a FHIR import job.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: startFHIRExportJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a FHIR export job.

methods.name: startFHIRImportJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a FHIR import job.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
